hint_fr: Faire dame semble évident. Mais que ferait la dame noire face à votre nouvelle dame ? Une autre pièce, en arrivant sur e8, pourrait toucher deux cibles d'un coup.
hint_en: Queening looks obvious. But what would Black's queen do against your new one? A different piece, landing on e8, could hit two targets at once.

claims.note: Syzygy tablebase (tablebase.lichess.ovh), checked 2026-10-08: e8=N+ is the ONLY winning move; e8=Q only DRAWS; e8=R, e8=B and every king or g-pawn move LOSE. After ...Kd7 (Black's longest defence, tied with ...Kc6), Nxd6 is the only win.
